In Australia, for tests taken on or after 23 April 2026, the minimum OET scores are Listening 350, Reading 360, Writing 350 and Speaking 360; tests taken on or before 22 April 2026 need B in Listening, Reading and Speaking and C+ in Writing. [RESPONSIBLE BODY · Ahpra — Accepted English language tests · read 2026-10-12]

The Nursing Council of New Zealand asks for at least 350 in Reading, Listening and Speaking and 300 in Writing, reached within 12 months of the first sitting; it does not accept online tests taken outside an approved test centre. [RESPONSIBLE BODY · Nursing Council of New Zealand — English language requirement · read 2026-10-12]

The UK's Nursing and Midwifery Council asks for at least grade B (350) in Listening, Reading and Speaking and at least C+ (300) in Writing. [RESPONSIBLE BODY · Nursing and Midwifery Council (UK) — Accepted English language tests · read 2026-10-12]

[RESPONSIBLE BODY · OET — Test regulations · read 2026-10-12]
